en: Look, there's the map I prepared for you guys.

Study it, and you'll know the Virtual World
like Tsumugi knows the back of her neck!

Huh? What about the back of my neck?
How did you know that spot's...sensitive?

O-Okay...I see.
The back of your neck, huh?

Why are you so interested in that?
You're gross...

First, let's check the map.
We gotta know more about this world.

There's nothing we can do about Kokichi...
Let's just check the rooftop.

Gonta dunno what to do... Gonta no can
be useful if he's weak...

You were checking out Tsumugi's
sensitive spot...?

Kaito, you nasty! I always knew you
were a closet pervert!

Wh-What are you saying!? You know I'm
not a sneaky guy like that!

W-Wait, so does that mean you're
openly a pervert, then...?
Two maps? Is the Virtual World really so big?

Kokichi is trying to manipulate Gonta again,
like he did with the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...
He is such a bothersome person...

This building is bigger than I thought... 
Looks like it's got a few different rooms.
But is it really okay to leave Kokichi alone?

Won't it be a problem if he finds 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> first?

Well, it's probably fine. Gonta's with him 
after all...

I don't think it could be hidden or 
tampered with.
You're right... Okay then, let's get started.

Let's check the rooftop. We gotta look 
at all the areas around here first.

...I'm not trying to act like Tenko or anything,
but guys really do fantasize about that a lot.
Or is it...
...What? Hurry up and check the map.
A trap...

There might be traps on the roof, too.
We should be careful.

Let's keep that stuff about the back of my neck
a secret. Don't put it up on the Internet, okay?

If it spreads, people will start trying to play
tricks on me during photoshoots...
Peek up her skirt...?

Every time Miu opens her mouth, a bunch 
of unnecessary garbage falls out...

Didn't I tell you the map's right there!?
Hurry the fuck up, blue-balls!

<CLT=cltMIND>There are two maps posted here, one
big and one small. I'll look at the latter.

<CLT=cltMIND>This map has "<CLT=cltSTRONG>mansion<CLT=cltMIND>"
written on it.

This is the map to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mansion<CLT=cltNORMAL>, which is
the building we're in right now.

This area is the entrance hall, and that
room with the phone is the salon.

The dining hall, kitchen, and bathroom are
also on the 1st floor.

There's no second floor...
but I do see a rooftop area.

The rooftop, huh? I guess that'd give us a 
good view. Let's go check it out later.
Yeah, good idea.

<CLT=cltMIND>But before we do, I should look at
this big map as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like a map of the
entire virtual world.

Listen up, shithead! Make sure you 
remember everything about this world!

It looks...pretty expansive.
It even continues past the river.

Is this an ellipsis here?
Showing that it continues?

Yeah, I'll tell you what that sign means later.
You'll understand once you actually go there.
<CLT=cltMIND>What could she mean by that?
Ah, there's another building here.

Yeah, it's just a dinky chapel. It was a
cluttered mess in there.
A lot of stuff, huh?

Maybe the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is hidden in there...

Oh, I just noticed... There are black lines
drawn around the <CLT=cltSTRONG>world map<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
But does that mean something?

Heh, how nice of ya to notice!
Of course it means somethin'!
This black line represents a wall!
A wall?

So, yeah... The Virtual World is actually
surrounded by a huge-ass wall.

Surrounded by a wall...? Are we trapped, 
even in this world!?

No, you're not trapped here. Beyond that
wall is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end of the world<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Literally.

Past that wall, nothing exists.
Everything ends there.
I see, so that wall is the end of the world.

By the way, Miu, you prepared these maps
yourself...
...not Monokuma, right?

Th-That's right...I prepared the maps.
What about it...?
No, it's nothing. I just wanted to know.

<CLT=cltMIND>What...? There was something off
about Miu's response...

We should be focusing on the more important
issue right now.

Yeah. Where in this world the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> is hidden...

But it's gonna be pretty hard to find something
when we have no clue what we're looking for.
...Where do you think you're going?

Hm? I was gonna go investigate alone. There's
a lot of interesting stuff I wanna check out.

Hey... Like hell am I gonna let you do 
whatever you want.
Whatever I want...?

And why do I need your permission, Kaito?
I'm free to do whatever I want.

I'm going, no matter what you guys say. Well,
it'd be a hassle if someone kept watch over me—
Kept watch?

Gonta not understand what's going on.
Gonta not sure how helpful he can be...

But Gonta can watch Kokichi so he not do
anything weird!

Gonta, you're so sweet...but I knew you'd
say that.

Even without your ridiculous physical strength,
as long as you're selfless and courageous...
You'd make a terrific bodyguard!
<CLT=cltMIND>Bodyguard?

With you by my side, I know I'll be safe from
any trap! Okie then, let's gooooo!
Ah, wait, Kokichi!

It's okay! Leave it to Gonta!
Gonta keep eye on Kokichi!
B-Bodyguard...? You mean Gonta?
It seems he planned this all along.

Geez...he really knows how 
to manipulate people.
Well, whatever. Let's go check out the rooftop.

Alright, follow me! If you wanna peek up my
skirt while you're at it, go for it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Maps of the mansion and the program world.
The smaller map is of the mansion.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the entrance hall, and the room
with the phone is the salon.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's also a dining room, kitchen,
and bathroom on the first floor.

<CLT=cltMIND>There is no second floor, but there
is a rooftop area.

<CLT=cltMIND>This bigger map is of the entire
program world.

<CLT=cltMIND>This world is pretty expansive.
It even goes past the bridge...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's an ellipsis here...
Miu said she'd explain what that meant later.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's also another building in the
virtual world—a small chapel.

<CLT=cltMIND>What a strange clock...
Is this Miu's taste?

<CLT=cltMIND>No, it can't be. This world was originally
created by Monokuma...

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like there are maps posted on
the wall. I should inspect these...
<CLT=cltMIND>I should check out the roof.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like there are maps posted on
the wall. I should inspect these...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll try going outside.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like there are maps posted on
the wall. I should inspect these...

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like there are maps posted on
the wall. I should inspect these...
<CLT=cltMIND>I should check out the roof.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll head outside.
